```blade
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Password Form</title>
    @livewireStyles
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-900">
    <div class="max-w-md mx-auto p-4 shadow-lg rounded-lg bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 overflow-hidden">
        <h1 class="text-xl font-semibold text-center mb-4">Password Form</h1>
        @livewire('password-form')
    </div>

    @livewireScripts
</body>
</html>
```

```php
// PasswordFormComponent.php

namespace App\Http\Livewire;

use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Livewire\Component;

class PasswordFormComponent extends Component
{
    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.password-form');
    }
}
```

```blade
<!-- resources/views/livewire/password-form.blade.php -->

<div class="container">
    <div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center mt-8">
        <form wire:submit.prevent="updatePassword">
            <div class="mb-4">
                <label for="current-password" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Current Password</label>
                <input type="password" id="current-password" class="mt-1 block w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring ring-indigo-500 dark:focus:bg-gray-900 dark:focus:border-gray-700 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-800" wire:model="currentPassword">
            </div>
            <div class="mb-4">
                <label for="new-password" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">New Password</label>
                <input type="password" id="new-password" class="mt-1 block w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring ring-indigo-500 dark:focus:bg-gray-900 dark:focus:border-gray-700 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-800" wire:model="newPassword">
            </div>
            <div class="mb-4">
                <label for="confirm-password" class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">Confirm Password</label>
                <input type="password" id="confirm-password" class="mt-1 block w-full p-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-md shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring ring-indigo-500 dark:focus:bg-gray-900 dark:focus:border-gray-700 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-800" wire:model="confirmPassword">
            </div>
            <button type="submit" class="w-full bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-bold py-2 px-4 rounded-lg shadow-md focus:outline-none focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:border-blue-500">Update Password</button>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
window.addEventListener('livewire:load', function() {
    document.getElementById('current-password').addEventListener('input', function() {
        const currentPassword = this.value;
        const newPassword = document.getElementById('new-password').value;
        const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirm-password').value;

        if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
            alert('Passwords do not match!');
        }
    });
});
</script>
```

This solution provides a complete Livewire blade view for the 'PasswordForm' component, including HTML/Blade code and JavaScript for form validation and interactions.
